questions.stem: The glomerular basement membrane is predominantly composed of which type of collagen:
questions.solutionHtml:
IV
  • The GBM consists of collagen-mostly type IV, laminin, polyanionic proteoglycans (mostly heparan sulfate), fibronectin, entactin, and several other glycoproteins.


Robbins & Cotran Pathologic Basis of Disease, 10th Edition, Page No. 550

Bowman’s space
  • Podocytes are specialized cells that are found in Bowman's capsule of the kidney and are important for the filtration function of the glomerulus.


Robbins & Cotran Pathologic Basis of Disease, 10th Edition, Page No. 550

questions.stem: The best special stain to detect the increased thickness of the glomerular basement membrane is-
questions.solutionHtml:
PAS
  • PAS (Periodic Acid-Schiff) stain is the best special stain to detect an increase in the thickness of the glomerular basement membrane.


Robbins & Cotran Pathologic Basis of Disease, 10th Edition, Page No. 550
